scope: Reusable game.formations in public project.test.* and CLI, independently tested as concurrent traffic rather than repeated single movers. Two private Game launches on the previously qualified native-saved forest, three known ground members per group, gate and north-road, Marine/Marauder, both directions. No universal topology, movement-plane, rigid-formation or engine collision/buildability claim.

implementation.manifest: 2..8 distinct same-type/owner members with declared ground mobility, world-XY offsets and named endpoints; default bidirectional. All shifted endpoints are contained in exact selected-archive MapInfo before launch.
implementation.movement: Submit all member orders before waiting. A pass needs at least two centers advancing between observation batches while still in transit and all members arriving within individual tolerances/corridors. Exact identity/type/owner/life/shields/spawn guards; loss/unknown observations cannot pass.
implementation.uncertainty: Sequential/end-only observations, timeout, death/control uncertainty or missing vitals remain inconclusive. Ambiguous creation/order is never retried and adds a required uncertainty marker even for an optional group. Cleanup and final private-session detach remain required.
implementation.frames: Optional viewId captures before cleanup with native camera/readback/hash checks and independent frame verdict. Group and final named-view files are distinct. MCP report supports exclusive formationId/direction or viewId image selectors.
implementation.cli: --formation ID --direction forward|reverse selects a digest-checked MCP image. Failed/uncertain/stale terminal reports are printed and stop before the next repeat; clean repeat2 retains the same bridge.

live.provenance: Byte-identical previously native-saved/recompiled ordinary archive; current formation manifests are Game-only and correctly report artifact origin source.
live.centerSeparationScope: Observed centers only, not a measured collision radius or footprint-clearance certificate.

retainedFailures.reason: A synthetic runtime omitted shields. The strict native-vitals prerequisite stayed active; the fixture was corrected to actual observed SDK fields.
The bounded observation loop initially excluded a sample exactly at the deadline. Inclusive boundary corrected without widening the timeout; final checks passed.
Constant-loop condition and useless initialization corrected without disabling rules.

openCoverage: Other terrain profiles, widths, crowd sizes, mixed unit types and combat/control conditions
Authoritative movement-plane/path/collision/buildability queries; current unsupported operations remain explicit
Main actor animations, ability visuals/sound/UI and other GUI/Data corpus coverage remain separate
Art refinement on forest/industrial/settlement layouts and gameplay quality remain incomplete
